videos.title: Sunday Afternoon
videos.description: with Simon Delaney. Join stage and screen actor Simon Delaney every Sunday afternoon, and indulge in a perfect musical blend for weekend listening.

videos.title: Weekend Classics
videos.description: with Claudia Boyle. It's all about oranges in this week's Musical Menu, Claudia celebrates Donizetti's birthday - do get in touch on 51554 and tell Claudia about your weekend.

videos.title: The Lyric Feature
videos.description: Claire Cunningham tells the stories of three poets whose work has been rediscovered: Dorothea Herbert, Florence Mary Wilson and Angela Greene.

videos.title: Mystery Train with John Kelly
videos.description: Mystery Train is a nightly journey through the many wonders of recorded music - from its vintage glories to the latest sounds. Essential listening for the discerning music fan.

videos.title: Vespertine with Ellen Cranitch
videos.description: Let Donal Dineen be your guide on a night-time voyage, crossing time and space to share a selection of classical, jazz, roots and contemporary music.

videos.title: Ambient Orbit
videos.description: A carefully crafted mix of ambient sounds and field recordings that allows the listener to reset and escape the noise of everyday life.

videos.title: Lyric Through the Night
videos.description: The best of classical music including full works, chamber music and RTÉ lyric fm's acclaimed CD releases.

videos.title: Marty in the Morning
videos.description: Join George as he takes the chill out of your early mornings with music, news, weather and travel updates.

videos.title: Niall Carroll's Classical Daytime
videos.description: Niall Carroll plays music from the heart of the classical repertoire including Five of a Kind at noon.

videos.title: The Full Score with Liz Nolan
videos.description: Liz Nolan presents a showcase of unabridged musical masterworks. Featuring live recordings of Irish and international performers, plus selections from the latest cd releases.

videos.title: Lorcan Murray's Classic Drive
videos.description: Lorcan brings you the perfect musical soundtrack, wherever you are, sharing a feast of music for both the curious and the knowledgeable and featuring listeners own choices.

videos.description: The Blue of the Night connects different musical landscapes - bringing you on a journey through centuries, genres and soundscapes.
